# DEMCiflex 200 mm round dust filter

<!-- Generated by make check from part.toml. Edit part.toml, not this file. -->

Fine mesh filter with a flexible rim, sold for 200 mm fans and vents (listed as
DF0496, black or white). DEMCiflex filters attach magnetically; the round 200 mm
listings don't say so explicitly, so confirm the magnet before relying on it to
hold to a steel fan grill. The square 200 mm model (DF0008) is listed as
discontinued at several retailers. Mesh adds pressure drop the 0.5 airflow derate
does not separately account for: measure the airflow with the filters in place.
